name: mac-agent-hygiene
description: Keeps a Mac that runs Claude Code agents from filling its disk: a daily LaunchAgent plus an MCP server that clears regenerable caches (Xcode DerivedData, leftover plugin clones, browser-profile caches) and reaps stale git worktrees that are clean and already pushed. Plan first, apply on confirm.

pillars.supervised: Every removal is planned first (dry run with per-item reasons) and applied only with an explicit plan_id + confirm; the scheduled run deletes only regenerable caches and worktrees that are clean, pushed and untouched for a week
pillars.orchestrated: status → plan → re-check → apply → log; one shell script decides eligibility in both plan and apply so nothing slips between them
pillars.secured: Local filesystem only, no network except an optional read-only gh query for merged PRs; never sudo; never login state inside browser profiles; never dirty or unpushed worktrees; paths outside $HOME refused
pillars.agents: R=mac-hygiene, T=bash+launchd+git+gh(read), M=30-min plan cache + append-only log, P=status-plan-confirm-apply
